title: Chris Foerster: 49ers are "very healthy," bumps and bruises come from practicing hard

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chris Foerster: 49ers are "very healthy," bumps and bruises come from practicing hard
sources.description: Chris Foerster, the San Francisco assistant who is filling in while head coach Kyle Shanahan recuperates from a car accident, says the narrative that the 49ers have been devastated with training camp injuries is incorrect.
